title: Introduction to clustermole
text: clustermole R package developed assist identifying candidate cell type labels single-cell RNA-seq (scRNA-seq) clusters. package includes three primary features: Retrieve human mouse cell type signatures clustermole_markers(). Compare set marker genes signatures using clustermole_overlaps(). Score signature enrichment across expression matrix without selecting marker genes using clustermole_enrichment(). three functions return tables can easily filtered, summarized, used workflows. reference meta-database combines cleans cell type markers multiple sources. See database details overview contents curation process. Sources differ studies, tissues, curation methods, selection criteria. marker may identify broad cell class, subtype, cell state. Comparing results across sources can reveal recurring candidates alternative labels worth investigating single source may miss.
